mentions.name: snack.game
mentions.description: A site where people can upload and share multiplayer games. It uses WebTransport instead of WebSockets for the networking transport, making the games feel better than typical web-based multiplayer games.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made a site https://snack.game where people can upload and share multiplayer games.

It uses webtransport instead of websockets for the networking transport so the games feel a lot better than normal web based multiplayer games.
